participation.context: Gave the verdict, stopped at the end, and refused a second time.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked the question she had held since four o'clock, and was answered.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Asked whether the houses were friends, and stayed with the house.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: one visit, and no appetite for a second

story.body: You let her take the time she had taken in the night. You answered Alse's question and did not make it an invitation. You did not measure the loaf, and you did not ask for a second visit.
